examples.input_condition: Local authority value is published on an end-user basis
examples.expected_action: Preserve basis=end_user and do not compare directly with by-source facility totals without reconciliation
examples.risk_prevented: Mixing energy-consumption allocation with physical release location

examples.input_condition: Local dataset row is expected to represent greenhouse gases
examples.expected_action: Limit this product scope to CO2, CH4 and N2O unless a separate official field explicitly adds another gas
examples.risk_prevented: Importing unrelated air-pollutant columns into the GHG layer

examples.input_condition: UK-level end-user total includes sources not attributable to a particular local authority
examples.expected_action: Do not force the national residual into local authorities or parcels; retain UNALLOCATED_NATIONAL residual
examples.risk_prevented: Artificial inflation of local totals

examples.input_condition: Fuel combustion includes a biofuel component
examples.expected_action: Exclude biogenic CO2 from these totals while retaining applicable non-CO2 biofuel emissions
examples.risk_prevented: Double counting or inconsistent biofuel treatment

examples.input_condition: Landfill methane occurs at a disposal site but the dataset reallocates waste emissions
examples.expected_action: Store physical_site and allocated_waste_producer geography separately
examples.risk_prevented: Treating allocation geography as the emitting facility

examples.input_condition: A 2005-2023 value differs between the 2023 and 2024 releases
examples.expected_action: Prefer the latest vintage for the full time series and retain prior_vintage provenance
examples.risk_prevented: Mixing vintages inside one trend

examples.input_condition: Row belongs to wastewater, landfill, shipping, agriculture or LULUCF
examples.expected_action: Mark as revision-sensitive for the 2024 release and require vintage-aware comparisons
examples.risk_prevented: Presenting methodology revision as real-world annual change

examples.input_condition: Interactive map identifies significant point sources
examples.expected_action: Treat visible points as significant-source context, not a complete inventory of all local emissions
examples.risk_prevented: Assuming map points sum to the local-authority total

examples.input_condition: Point-source value is unchanged across releases
examples.expected_action: Do not manufacture a revision; retain unchanged status unless new data or methodology affects it
examples.risk_prevented: False change detection

examples.input_condition: Installation fuel and emissions data are used in local estimates
examples.expected_action: Preserve that ETS operator data are reconciled to national DUKES energy statistics before allocation
examples.risk_prevented: Using raw operator fuel as final local total

examples.input_condition: Shipping emissions exist in the national inventory
examples.expected_action: Allocate only the portions the official methodology assigns to local areas and keep the remainder outside LA totals
examples.risk_prevented: Forcing all shipping emissions into coastal authorities

examples.input_condition: LULUCF row can be an emission or a removal
examples.expected_action: Preserve signed values and the gas-specific basis; never clamp removals to zero
examples.risk_prevented: Destroying net-removal information

examples.input_condition: Overall local uncertainty is being calculated
examples.expected_action: Keep LULUCF uncertainty separate where the official analysis excludes it because it can dominate other sectors
examples.risk_prevented: Masking uncertainty patterns in other sectors

examples.input_condition: National uncertainty percentages must be mapped to local sectors
examples.expected_action: Use emissions-weighted subsector and fuel aggregation as documented; do not average percentages arithmetically
examples.risk_prevented: Biased uncertainty estimates

examples.input_condition: A row comes from the protected-landscapes workbook
examples.expected_action: Keep product_scope=protected_landscape and do not merge as if it were an ordinary local-authority row
examples.risk_prevented: Geography duplication

examples.input_condition: An activity appears in both air-pollution and GHG products
examples.expected_action: Require gas and product identity; do not equate pollutant totals with GHG CO2e totals
examples.risk_prevented: Cross-product unit and substance confusion

examples.input_condition: A permit does not explicitly list every relevant pollutant
examples.expected_action: Still evaluate and report all applicable pollutants from permitted activities, including direct and fugitive sources
examples.risk_prevented: Omitting relevant releases

examples.input_condition: Release records include multiple emission points
examples.expected_action: Aggregate total annual mass by substance and environmental medium while retaining point/fugitive components
examples.risk_prevented: Comparing partial source values with annual totals

examples.input_condition: A local Environment Agency instruction requires actual values instead of BRT
examples.expected_action: Use the documented actual-value convention and retain the local instruction provenance
examples.risk_prevented: Replacing required values with BRT text

examples.input_condition: A regulator-approved substance or process methodology exists
examples.expected_action: Apply the agreed method instead of the default LOD procedure and record method_id
examples.risk_prevented: Ignoring an approved method

examples.input_condition: Combustion units at a site total more than 20 MW rated thermal input
examples.expected_action: Create an installation-scope candidate, except where the primary purpose is hazardous or municipal waste incineration
examples.risk_prevented: Applying the threshold without its stated exception

examples.input_condition: A vessel is below 5000 gross tonnage
examples.expected_action: Do not include it through the general 5000 GT maritime rule unless a separate official inclusion applies
examples.risk_prevented: Over-expanding maritime scope

examples.input_condition: Vessel activity is international-only and not an in-port UK activity
examples.expected_action: Do not classify it as covered domestic voyage activity solely because the operator is UK-linked
examples.risk_prevented: Confusing operator nationality with voyage scope

examples.input_condition: A maritime operator uses a potentially eligible sustainable fuel
examples.expected_action: Apply zero emission factor only after a successful official emissions-reduction claim
examples.risk_prevented: Granting zero emissions from fuel label alone
